title: Rethinking Semantic Alignment in LLM-Enhanced Collaborative Filtering: A Spectral Decoupling Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.24363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in LLM-enhanced recommendation commonly align semantic representations with collaborative embeddings in a shared space, yet how alignment affects LLM-encoded information remains unclear. In this work, we revisit LLM-enhanced recommendation from a spectral perspective and show that collaborative and semantic signals benefit from different spectral parts. While collaborative representations are dominated by smooth low-frequency components due to user-item homophily, semantic embeddings contain useful non-principal singular components. Through component-wise evaluation and training-dynamics analysis, we find that alignment increasingly concentrates learned representations in dominant collaborative and principal semantic subspaces, reducing overlap with non-principal semantic components. translated_title: 重新思考大语言模型增强协同过滤中的语义对齐：一种谱解耦方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24363v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期在大语言模型增强推荐系统中的进展，通常会在共享空间中将语义表示与协同嵌入进行对齐，然而这种对齐如何影响大语言模型编码的信息仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们从谱的角度重新审视大语言模型增强推荐，并表明协同信号和语义信号受益于不同的谱部分。由于用户-物品的同质性，协同表示主要由平滑的低频分量主导，而语义嵌入则包含有用的非主奇异分量。通过分量级评估和训练动态分析，我们发现对齐逐渐将学习到的表示集中在主导协同和主语义子空间中，减少了与非主语义分量的重叠。受控比较表明，非主分量在对齐下提供不一致的增益，但始终能提升性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种谱解耦方法，揭示大语言模型增强协同过滤中语义对齐过度集中于主分量，而非主语义分量虽在对齐下增益不稳定，却能持续提升推荐性能，从而重新思考了对齐策略的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a spectral decoupling approach, revealing that semantic alignment in LLM-enhanced collaborative filtering over-concentrates on principal components, while non-principal semantic components, despite inconsistent gains under alignment, consistently improve performance, prompting a rethink of alignment strategies.
